research_correction.Royer_physical_role: Retain as a self-oscillating push-pull host power cell: main MOS + center-tapped primary + HFT + magnetic feedback/self-oscillation.
research_correction.Royer_submechanism_role: Magnetic-state self-oscillation remains separately falsifiable as a timing/commutation mechanism.
research_correction.method: Add power/magnetic/energy-transfer bricks around the Royer host and compute P/V/I/RMS/gain/loss before detailed switching-state design.

screening_candidates.RH1: 3-cell Royer host, low-voltage input-parallel, secondary-series contribution; KEEP
screening_candidates.RH4: RH1 + capacitive gain directly at 12 V; HOLD_HIGH_CURRENT_RISK
screening_candidates.RH5: RH1 + current-fed + resonant + magnetic sharing; PRIMARY_POWER_BRICK_COMBINATION_TO_SCREEN
screening_candidates.RH6: RH1 + resonant + capacitive gain after partial magnetic step-up; SECONDARY_POWER_BRICK_COMBINATION_TO_SCREEN

clarification.RH1_assumption: The 12-V inputs of the three Royer cells are fed in parallel from the same source, while the high-voltage secondary contributions are series-added for the first-order screen.

next_gate: Build one matched power/loss ledger for RH1 vs RH5 vs RH6; only the survivor may proceed to exact switching-state design and PSIM.
